"Holiday Greetings"

“ Even during Chuseok, my feelings for you are unchanged... No, not enough. „

Chuseok Greetings (Korean: 명절날 전하는 인사, myeongjeollal jeonhaneun insa, "Holiday Greetings") is Cotton Candy Cookie's third Costume, released in the first half of the Mystery on the SS Cargot update. It is an Epic Costume that can be obtained by drawing it from the Vintage Costume Jar in the Gem Exchange Center.

Story

Cotton Candy Cookie always gives her best when it comes to sharing her heart. This Chuseok, she has decided to help other Cookies deliver their messages, especially those who struggle to express their feelings! Anyone who is unable to visit home for the holidays can ask her for a rainbow rice cake scroll to write a message, and she'll wait by the village gate to make sure it's delivered to the right Cookie.
Thank you, Cotton Candy Cookie, for make sure these precious letters reach their destination...!

Trivia

  • Chuseok Greetings was released alongside  Chuseok Courtesies,  Uninvited "VIP", and  Polished and Peckish.
  • Chuseok Greetings was originally obtainable by purchasing it from the Gem Exchange Center during the Mystery on the SS Cargot update.

Punkromantic Fashion Show Model (Korean: 로맨틱펑키 패션쇼 모델, romaentikpongki paesyonssyo model) is Cotton Candy Cookie's second Costume, released in the first half of the Project Cookie Runway update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

"Can rock-and-roll be lovely too? If you answered yes, you understood this fashion show perfectly. Cotton Candy Cookie's dress is rich in blueberry lace, and the velvet choco heart decoration brings out the charm of the whole look. Rumor has it that VIPs will each receive a special letter..."
- Cogue Magazine

Trivia

  • Punkromantic Fashion Show Model was released alongside  Crown Punky S/S Collection Modeland  Romantic Sugar S/S Collection Model.

Name in Other Languages

Korean

사랑의 배달부
sarange baedalbu

“ When you read this letter... Um, no! „

Love Messenger (Korean: 사랑의 배달부, sarange baedalbu) is Cotton Candy Cookie's first Costume, released in the second half of the Grand Champions League update. It is a Rare Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it with Rainbow Cubes.

Story

On a warm spring day, a shy knock at the door might wake you from your daydreaming. It will be the Love Messenger holding a little letter in both hands.

Trivia

  • Love Messenger's theme around the postal service is a direct reference to Cotton Candy Cookie's obsession over writing love letters, going so far as to now even personally deliver them.
  • Love Messenger appears in Cookie Run: Puzzle World during the Delivery Mistake event, where the player helps her retrieve her lost letters before they can be read.
